title: THE SINKHOLE · The ground
venue: The Unprinted · a Sunday page from a paper he never drew for, found in Box 5 in the private years
logline: The second page of the found Sunday: a street in a river town, a riverboat at its landing, and the street opening — a hole the width of the page's middle tier, the boat listing into it, a man on the helm above the dining room not letting go of the wheel. The line is almost Wood's. The rain is not his rain.

panels.composition: A full Sunday page in three tiers: a river town's street with a paddlewheel boat at a landing; the street opening into a ragged hole the width of the middle tier with the boat listing into it; a man at the helm above the dining room holding the wheel as the deck tilts. Rain drawn as dots, not hatching.
